relevance_note: Table 2 gives patient-level clinical history for the HA20 cohort ('Detailed clinical history of all 16 patients included').
method_note: Hand-read the whole paper; a short Python script transcribed Table 2 (one row per patient; columns in order: Patient number | Family | History of mouth ulcers | History of Genital ulcers | History of gut symptoms | History of colitis/gut ulcers | Liver disease | GI symptoms on collection day | Colchicine on collection day | Other DMARDs on collection day) and I checked its output against the table row by row. Labels are the verbatim 'Patient number' values (1-16); family labels are the verbatim 'Family' values (1-6). Table 2 has no legend defining 0 or 1. '1' was read as present (column counts match the text: mouth ulcers 16/16, genital ulcers 13, gut symptoms 13, colchicine 5, adalimumab/azathioprine 6 = 'six were receiving immunosuppressants'); '0' was recorded as not reported under the v3 table-symbol rule, so no feature is excluded. Group-level data (sex 12 females, median age 29.5, BMI, interferon signature 5/5, liver MRI in 5 patients, histology in 1-4 patients, 'one patient treated with TNF-α' in the Discussion, 'no patient displayed auto-antibodies specific to PSC') could not be attributed to numbered patients and were not recorded per person. No TNFAIP3 variant is printed and the paper never ties a specific variant to a patient (only 'mutational status' extracted from medical records), so no variant rows were emitted. Contradictions/oddities: Table 1 'Females | 12 (71)' (12/16 is 75%) and controls 'Females 25 (78)' with n = 22; Table 1 'Abdominal pain 4 (25)' on collection day vs 3 patients with 'GI symptoms on collection day' = 1 in Table 2; Table 2 'Liver disease' = 1 for 5 patients vs 'Elevated liver enzymes were noted in 4 patients' (may be different definitions); spleen length '163 and 160 cm'.

n_patients_reported.span: Sixteen patients from 6 families of European ancestry with HA20 were studied

cohort_size_as_stated.span: This study included 16 HA20 patients and 22 healthy age and sex‐matched controls
